verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for an inference API platform. The evidence only shows that a generic Groq API key is passed to the client, plus account-level spend limits. Neither documents per-key scopes, permissions or least-privilege restrictions, and spend limits are an adjacent control that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
